problem: The text says a DSL line on α = 0.25 pays 12.5 % extra bandwidth. Excess bandwidth is αR_s/2, which is 25 % of the Nyquist minimum R_s/2, not 12.5 %.
fix: Change to 'pays 25 % extra bandwidth' (or 'pays an excess bandwidth of 0.125R_s, i.e. 25 % above the Nyquist minimum').

problem: Two technical errors. (i) 'At every t = kT ... the denominator is not [zero]' is false: for α = 0.5 and k = ±1 the denominator 1 − (2αk)² is zero. (ii) 'At t = ±T/(2α) ... the limit there is π/4' is wrong for the pulse: the limit is (π/4) sinc(1/(2α)), not π/4.
fix: Say: 'At t = kT (k ≠ 0), p(kT) = 0; where the denominator also vanishes, take the limit. At t = ±T/(2α) the ratio cos(...)/(1 − (2αt/T)²) tends to π/4, so p = (π/4) sinc(1/(2α)).'

problem: The slope-at-zero-crossing bullet is backwards. A steep crossing makes the horizontal eye opening wider and increases tolerance to timing jitter; a gradual crossing narrows it.
fix: Replace with: 'Slope at the zero crossing: a steep crossing gives a wide horizontal opening, so the eye tolerates more timing jitter. A gradual crossing narrows the opening and makes the eye timing-sensitive.'

problem: The caption says 'no single block is a raised cosine by itself', but the figure includes a block labelled 'Overall p(t) raised cosine'. This can confuse a reader.
fix: Say 'no single filter block is a raised cosine by itself; only their cascade is.'
